entities.summary: The Mausoleum of Ahmad al-Rifa'i also known as Dargah Syed Ahmad Kabeer Rifa'i is a Sufi religious complex dedicated to Ahmad al-Rifa'i, the founder of the Rifa'i Sufi order, located in Al-Rifa'i District, Maysan Governorate, Iraq. It comprises a mosque, a room for hadra, and the mausoleum of Ahmad al-Rifa'i himself.
